3M manages its operations in five business segments: Industrial, Safety and Graphics, Health Care, Electronics and Energy, and Consumer.
3M's five operating business segments are: Industrial; Safety and Graphics; Health Care; Electronics and Energy; and Consumer.
3M segments its businesses into five segments: Industrial; Safety and Graphics; Health Care; Electronics and Energy; and Consumer.

Major products in the Industrial segment include tapes, coated and bonded abrasives, adhesives, advanced ceramics, sealants, specialty materials, filtration products, closure systems for personal hygiene products, acoustic systems products, automotive components, abrasion-resistant films, structural adhesives, and paint finishing and detailing products.

Major products in the Safety and Graphics segment include personal protection products, transportation safety solutions, commercial graphics systems, commercial cleaning and protection products, floor matting, roofing granules for asphalt shingles, fall protection products, self-contained breathing apparatus systems, and gas and flame detection instruments.

Major products in the Health Care segment include medical and surgical supplies, skin health and infection prevention products, drug delivery systems, dental and orthodontic products, health information systems, and food safety products.

Major products in the Electronics and Energy segment include optical films solutions for electronic displays, packaging and interconnection devices, insulating and splicing solutions for the electronics and electrical industries, touch screens and touch monitors, renewable energy component solutions, and infrastructure protection products.

Major products in the Consumer segment include consumer and office tapes and adhesives, repositionable notes, indexing systems, home improvement products, furnace filters, painter tapes, mounting products, home care products, sponges, scouring pads, high-performance clothes, protective material products, and adhesive bandages and braces.
